notes.title: Version 0.3.0.0 Released
notes.content:
Additions:
Remade the wood collection minigame background. There are now layers that dynamically change with the weather.

Added weather effects to the wood collection minigame.

Added an in-game progression system. Earn XP by completing runs and unlock new things.

Added something secret.

notes.title: Version 0.2.0.0 Released
notes.content:
Additions
Added a "mental health" bar above survivors

Added an "energy" bar above survivors

Added small icons next to all status bars to improve readability

Added the "sleep" status

Added the ability to progress through days

Added the ability to cycle through actions by clicking the actions above or below the currently selected action

Added a debug FPS tracker to monitor fps during development
Changes
Survivors recover +2 energy overnight instead of +1 energy

Talking no longer requires an action point nor does it consume energy
